content: LiteLLM's supports_response_schema() returns False for openrouter/* models because OpenRouter is not in its internal structured-output support list; the OpenRouter adapter silently strips a top-level response_format kwarg passed to litellm.completion()/acompletion(). Confirmed workaround (GitHub BerriAI/litellm discussion #11652, and issues #13438/#10465): nest response_format INSIDE the extra_body dict instead of passing it top-level, e.g. extra_body={"response_format": {...}, "provider": {...}}. This bypasses LiteLLM's internal schema-support gate entirely.
